_doc: D77 (WS-39 S6f) — is a task hidden from my inbox for now? Hidden until the LATER of my own defer_until and the task's shared start_date. Offsets are in days from now: defer_days moves an instant, start_days moves a DATE (0 is today, which is shown). Readers: tests/unit/test_projects_personal_s6f.py (personal.not_yet), tests/live/live_ws39_s6f.py (personal.DEFERRED_CLAUSE on Postgres), workbench/control_plane/src/app/tasks/lib/sharedFields.test.ts (utils.ts isTickled).
_doc_explicit_today: F5 (2026-09-24) — the same rule with an explicit instant and IANA zone, so both sides compute the SAME member date. 'today' is that date. Readers: test_projects_personal_s6f.py (personal.local_date + not_yet), sharedFields.test.ts (utils.ts localDate + isTickled with the zone), and live_ws39_s6f.py (DEFERRED_CLAUSE with :today on Postgres).
